verdict.rationale: BILL Spend & Expense's core product marketing and docs describe real-time transaction categorization ('every transaction is controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant'), receipt/coding automation via AI (Invoice Coding Agent, multi-line coding), custom approval policies, and automatic 2-way sync to accounting systems (QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Dynamics) — directly supporting spend being coded in real time so month-end close is a review not reconstruction. Webhooks and audit trail APIs further support continuous, real-time reconciliation rather than after-the-fact archaeology. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence (e.g., customer reviews or case studies) confirming receipt capture and memo/category coding accuracy in practice, and no explicit mention of receipt-matching workflow details in this specific evidence pack.
